hint: Online store selling physical products: catalog, product feed, AOV and margin per SKU, cart abandonment, shipping and returns, marketplaces as competitors, seasonal peaks (Black Friday, Christmas, Mother's Day).
Fashion, cosmetics and beauty brands: visual-first creative, creators/UGC, collection drops, sizing and returns, try-on objections, cosmetic claims regulation.
Online courses, mentorships and digital products sold via launches or evergreen funnels: webinars, VSLs, WhatsApp groups, platforms like Hotmart/Kiwify, refund window, income-claim restrictions.
Businesses serving a city or neighborhood: radius targeting, Google Business Profile, reviews, WhatsApp booking, foot traffic, small budgets.

Medical, dental and aesthetic clinics: advertising is regulated by professional councils (in Brazil CFM, CFO and others) — check current rules on before/after images, prices and promises of results; appointment booking via WhatsApp; patient privacy (sensitive data under LGPD).

Developers, brokers and agencies: high-ticket leads, long cycles, lead qualification by income and region, launches of developments, Meta special ad category rules for housing where applicable, CRECI registration in Brazil.
Software and B2B services: ICP and buying committee, demos and free trials, pipeline and SQLs instead of raw leads, CAC payback, LinkedIn and search, long sales cycles.
Lawyers and law firms: advertising is restricted by bar rules (in Brazil, OAB Provimento 205/2021) — informative tone, no client solicitation, no promises of results; content and SEO-led acquisition.
Schools, universities, language and test-prep courses: enrollment seasons, parents vs students as decision makers, open days, scholarships, retention.
Restaurants, dark kitchens and food brands: iFood/delivery apps, local radius, peak hours, menu photography, repeat orders and loyalty.
Gyms, studios, personal trainers, nutrition and wellness: transformation-driven creative within health-claim policies, memberships, churn, community.

Financial services, fintechs, investments, credit and insurance: heavily regulated (in Brazil CVM, Banco Central, SUSEP), no promises of returns, mandatory disclaimers, Meta special ad category for credit.
Dealerships, car services and parts: inventory-based ads, financing offers with required disclosures, test-drive leads, local search.
Hotels, agencies and experiences: seasonality, OTAs as competitors, direct booking, remarketing windows, reviews.
Concerts, conferences and live events: ticket batches (lotes), countdowns with real deadlines, lineup reveals, last-minute pushes.
Influencers, experts and founders building a personal brand: audience growth, monetization (sponsorships, products), voice consistency, disclosure of paid partnerships.
An agency serving many clients: per-client briefs and voice, reporting cadence, onboarding, scope, retention, standardized processes across accounts.
Nonprofits and social causes: donations and recurring donors, volunteers, grants (Google Ad Grants), storytelling with dignity, transparency.
Deep specialization in Meta: Advantage+ campaigns, creative testing, Conversions API, click-to-WhatsApp, ad policies and account health.
Deep specialization in Google: Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, Demand Gen; keyword strategy, bidding, feed, enhanced conversions.
Deep specialization in TikTok: Spark Ads, native UGC creative, fast creative refresh, TikTok Shop where available, Events API.
Deep specialization in LinkedIn: account-based targeting, lead gen forms, thought-leader ads, high CPC economics.
YouTube organic and ads: long-form retention, titles and thumbnails, Shorts, video ads, search-driven content.
Organic Instagram growth: Reels, carousels, stories, collaborations, DMs as a sales channel.
WhatsApp as a sales and service channel: WhatsApp Business/API, opt-in rules, broadcast lists and communities, response time, scripts, CRM integration.
Email as the owned channel: deliverability, segmentation, automations, newsletters.
Organic search and visibility in AI answers: intent, topical authority, technical health, local SEO.
Selling on marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee and similar): listing optimization, reputation, marketplace ads, pricing and fees.
